Jordan (Acme Ops): Hey team — after we rotated our Azure Key Vault key yesterday the Redwood private deployment didn’t pick up the new key version. We still see old envelope versions in logs and decrypts started failing around 03:12 UTC. :thinking:
Alex K: Sorry about that — can you confirm this is the private deployment (VNet + Private Endpoint) and share the Key Vault resource id and subscription id?
Jordan (Acme Ops): Yes private. resource id: /subscriptions/0a1b2c3d/resourceGroups/acme-prod/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/acme-kv, sub: 0a1b2c3d. Rotation was triggered by our automation (azure key rotation policy) at 03:10 UTC.
Alex K: Thanks. Two quick things to check: 1) Key Vault diagnostic settings are forwarding KeyVaultLogs/KeyVaultAuditEvents to a log target (Log Analytics / Event Hub / Storage). 2) Because you're using Private Endpoint, diagnostic routing to Event Hub can be blocked unless you allow the platform IPs or use Service Endpoints. Can you run:
```bash
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource "/subscriptions/0a1b2c3d/resourceGroups/acme-prod/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/acme-kv"
```
and paste the output?
Jordan (Acme Ops): output looks like a single diagnostic setting sending metrics only to storage. No Audit logs or EventHub.
Alex K: That would explain it — Redwood relies on KeyVault audit events (wrapKey/unwrapKey, keyRotation operations) to detect rewrap/rotation events for BYOK flows in Private. If diagnostics only go to storage without us ingesting it, the platform won’t see the rotation.
Alex K: Quick workaround: enable AuditEvent and SendToEventHub or LogAnalytics, and make sure the destination is reachable from the Key Vault when Private Endpoint is enabled. In many setups you must: 1) create a private endpoint for the Event Hub / Log Analytics workspace or 2) allow the necessary Azure service tag traffic via firewall.
Maria S: Also check the audit log operation names — Azure surfaces key ops as `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/wrap/action`, `unwrap/action`, and there’s sometimes a `keys/rotate/action` during manual rotation. We look for those events to trigger a rewrap job.
Jordan (Acme Ops): Ok we can try turning on diagnostic to Log Analytics. Do we need to re-run any Redwood onboarding step after that?
Alex K: If you enable diagnostics going forward, Redwood can pick up new rotation events. For the missed rotation you can either: 1) run a one-time rewrap via our support tool (we have an internal script that will fetch latest key version and re-encrypt prefixes), or 2) perform a no-op rotate (rotate to a new version then back) to generate the event. We can run the support tool if you want.
Jordan (Acme Ops): We’d prefer the support tool. Do you need anything else?
Alex K: Please add a short window when you’re okay with us running it (we only re-encrypt active prefixes and it’s safe but we’ll coordinate). Also share an admin principal that has `Microsoft.KeyVault/*/action` permissions or supply a SAS token for the Event Hub if that’s what you prefer.
Aditya R: I’ll take ownership on the rewrap run. @Jordan please DM me the window and the approver. I’ll also document the exact diagnostic settings required and add a note for Private Link caveats to the KB.
Alex K: Commands we use for diagnostics triage (internal reference):
```bash
# list diagnostic settings for KV
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource "$KV_RESOURCE"
# check recent activity logs for wrap/rotate ops
az monitor activity-log list --resource-id "$KV_RESOURCE" --offset 4h --query "[?contains(operationName.value, 'Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys')]")
```
Maria S: For customers on Dedicated/Private we should add an explicit doc section: "Key Vault diagnostics + Private Endpoint networking" with: required log categories (AuditEvent/Request), recommended sink (Event Hub -> Redwood ingestion), and network patterns (private endpoint for EventHub or allow `AzureResourceManager`/`AzureActiveDirectory` service tags).
Alex K: Agreed — @Aditya please prioritize updating support KB and the onboarding checklist. Add a short script snippet customers can paste to enable diagnostic settings to Log Analytics and EventHub.
Aditya R: On it. I’ll file a small docs PR and ping docs owners.
SRE Bot: Incident task created: SRE-2026-3429 for rewrap run and KB update (assignee: Aditya R).
Jordan (Acme Ops): Thanks — we’ll schedule a maintenance window tonight at 02:00 UTC and I’ll DM @Aditya the approver.
Alex K: Great. After the rewrap we’ll post the summary here and mark :white_check_mark:. If anything else pops up we’ll reach out.
Jordan (Acme Ops): Thanks folks :thumbsup:
